degree.text: Degree Awarded Master of Business Administration

description.text: Program Highlight 1．One of the fifth batch MBA experimental units granted by the Degree Office of the State Council. 2．Overall advantage of the university brand, for CUFE has won high reputation in history. 3．Strong discipline advantages in finance and economics. 4．With the relatively centralized management system of the MBA Programmes, it is accessible to integrate high-quality resources from all faculties. Program Introduction The MBA is designed to cultivate business management executives of the future for senior leadership positions in China and globally. Studying an MBA in China equips students with strategic foresight and entrepreneurial spirit as well as decision-making and problem-solving capabilities. Teaching Objective To help student obtain knowledge and ability of business management, economic management and enterprise management, and enable student to deal with all kinds of business management related work in all kinds of organizations. Main Courses Principles of Management,macro-economics,Management Information System, Statistics, Accounting, Finance Management, Marketing,Economic Law,Human Resource Management,Enterprise Strategic Management. Fee Structure Tuition fee：26000RMB/year Insurance: RMB 600/ per year, RMB 400/per half year Internship Human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise. Duration 2 years Degree Awarded Master of Business Administration Future Career Banking, consultancy, accountancy, marketing, advertising, human resource management and general management.

duration.text: The Business Administration at Central University of Finance and Economics is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Two Recommendation letters From Professors, associate professors or equivalents.

requirements.text: Bachelor’s degree, Higher proficiency in Chinese, Good health
